name: termos
description: Termos is an interactive TUI that enhances Claude Code with rich visual components. WORKFLOW: 1) `termos run --title "Title" <component> [args]` sends an interaction and returns an ID, 2) `termos wait <id>` blocks until user responds. COMPONENTS: confirm (yes/no prompts before destructive actions), progress (multi-step task tracking with --steps), diff (code review before commits), table (structured data display), code (syntax-highlighted file viewer), json (formatted JSON/API responses), ask (quick user questions), chart (data visualization). WHEN TO USE: Before deleting files, deploying, or destructive operations use confirm. For multi-step tasks use progress. Before git commits show diff. For structured output use table/json. Always include --title. Run `termos --help` or `termos run --help` for details. The user runs `termos tui` in a separate terminal to see and respond to interactions.
